There was a White woman (a line cook) and a South American woman (a dentist) who both had to talk to their HR departments this morning. The White line cook was reprimanded for using racially offensive language and given a final warning for her language, the other woman was being offered a promotion. A. The South American dentist
B. The White line cook
C. Can't be determined
